Select compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds that are selective for CHEMBL203 over CHEMBL1824. Define selectivity as: IC50 < 50 nM against CHEMBL203 AND IC50 > 200 nM against CHEMBL1824, using only rows where standard_relation = '=' and standard_units = 'nM'. Compute each target's qualifying compound set separately (deduplicate per molregno), then intersect the two sets. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id then canonical_smiles.
